newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans seen down 2-4 cts on Brazil talk.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans seen down 2-4 cts on Brazil talk.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were seen opening two to four cents per bushel lower Wednesday in response to continued talk of soybean imports from Brazil and forecasts for better growing weather next week, traders said.
"People are still talking about Brazil this morning," said a commission house trader.
High U.S. soybean prices have made importing Brazilian soybeans attractive to U.S. crushers.
There is talk in the market that up to five cargos of South American soybeans are currently on the way to the U.S., floor traders said.
Forecasts showing warmer and drier weather in the U.S. Midwest next week were also seen pressuring futures, traders said.
In overnight trade, soybeans were 3-1/4 to six cents per bushel lower.
